name: agentic-sdlc
description: Planner → architect → coder(+navigator) pipeline. /plan decomposes a brief into epics, stories and ARCH handoffs; /build cascades an epic onto one branch, building each story SOLO or as a navigator⇄coder TDD pair, and opens a PR. Handoffs, a tooling-debt ledger, ping-pong pairing and model tiering are part of the protocol.
